verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own graph view, where each link between notes becomes a line so you can see connections around an object. However, the docs describe only the local neighbourhood of the open note, not exploration of the whole knowledge base, and nothing in the pack mentions filtering the graph. missing for 10: documented filtering of the graph by type/tag/query, a whole-knowledge-base (global) graph, explicit interactivity details, independent or hands-on corroboration
